text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(...She is a curious person. She's been 
that way since the day we met...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
N-Nice to meet you! My name is Yukino 
Bijin, and I'm from Morioka! 
I look forward to rooming with ya starting 
today!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(...Even as I returned her greeting, I 
didn't think we would remain together for 
long. 
I was already used to having my roommates 
change.)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(Because everyone is frightened. By the 
unseen presence that lingers beside me. 
...And yet.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh my goodness...? You sure are energetic 
today, aren'tcha...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*—Well, makin' noise at night ain't 
no different than a cat. 
No point frettin' over it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —Yukino-san. ...May I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"... 
Being around me... doesn't it frighten 
you?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Huh? Not once have I ever thought that!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"You're so very kind, Cafe-san. You're 
always gentle to things seen... and things 
unseen..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe... And you always brew such 
delicious coffee for someone clumsy like 
me, too."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Truly, it feels almost too luxurious. 
Getting to chat with you like this... 
while enjoying the coffee you make."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"... 
That's... for me, too—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(I feel the exact same way, Yukino-san... 
That's why I—)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for your hard work today, 
Cafe-san! 
Please, you should head on home now."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...? 
Yukino-san... aren't you leaving as well?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... 
I just have a quick thing to discuss with 
Ticket-san—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—Could our customer numbers... be 
decreasing...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, our sales numbers dropped a little, 
so it just caught my eye! The Wagashi 
Showdown is lively as ever, so it might 
just be my imagination!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... Maybe we haven't promoted enough? 
We haven't handed out many flyers since 
the showdown started..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Then we've just gotta step up our 
promotions!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"It won't do if the excitement dies down 
before Valentine's! I'll ask around and 
put up posters all over the place—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ...um... Yukino-san, taking on any 
more...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...No, ...well... please, don't overexert 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"No way, it's only natural to do at least 
this much! Besides, right now is the 
crucial moment!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"*Yaaawn*... Whoops! No good, gotta stay 
fired up...! Tomorrow I'll wake up early 
and hand out flyers, and...!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(...This is what's 'natural' to 
Yukino-san. 
Yet... by that 'naturalness'...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: (...I don't want to see her crushed...!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...*breathe*... *breathe*...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"... 
You really were exhausted, weren't 
you...?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Please rest, Yukino-san. 
Even if only for a little while..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: (...I will take your place.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Mmm. Feels like we've exhausted all the 
combining ideas. In that case... let's 
think up a transforming wagashi!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"If we only focus on 'romance', maybe we 
won't stand out enough from the other 
shops. The wagashi's 'brilliance' that 
we've still overlooked—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —The gyuhi dough for testing... is ready.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, thank you, Cafe-chan! 
Wait... shouldn't you take a break soon? 
Haven't you been on your feet non-stop?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"No, this much... is fine. 
...I will go ahead and do the prep work 
for tomorrow, then."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(Even just a little... I want to shoulder 
her burden in her place—)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Cafe-san? A-Are you alright? 
You haven't been lookin' too well 
lately..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"I am... fine. 
...More importantly, Yukino-san, you—"

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"...Yukino-chan is right. 
Overworking is strictly forbidden. Go on, 
rest in the back."

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Just seeing how hard you're working for 
this shop makes me more than happy 
enough..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"... 
Not at all... I am merely..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"!! Cafe-san...? 
...Cafe-saaaan!!"
